steps.title: Neutralize Perchloric Acid Extracts
steps.instruction: Neutralize perchloric acid-extracts by adding sodium hydroxide (Bio Basic Inc. Catalog #SB0617.SIZE.500G) until a pH of 7 is reached.

steps.title: Determine Serum Glucose
steps.instruction: Determine glucose in serum samples using the glucose oxidase reaction with the Glucosa-LQ GOD-POD kit (SPINREACT). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum Insulin
steps.instruction: Determine insulin in serum samples using the Human Insulin ELISA kit (ELH-Insulin-2 RayBio, USA). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum HbA1C
steps.instruction: Determine HbA1C in serum samples using the glycosylated HbA1c kit (BoiSys-Kovalent, Brazil; 4190045K R1 2). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum Triglycerides
steps.instruction: Determine triglycerides in serum samples using the GPO-POD enzimatic colorimetric kit (Spinreact, Spain). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum Uric Acid
steps.instruction: Determine uric acid in serum samples using the Uricase-POD Enzimatic colorimetric kit (Spinreact, Spain). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum AST
steps.instruction: Determine AST in serum samples using the NADH.Cinetic UV.IFCC kit (Spinreact, Spain). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum ALT
steps.instruction: Determine ALT in serum samples using the NADH.Cinetic UV.IFCC kit (Spinreact, Spain). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Determine Serum Cholesterol
steps.instruction: Determine cholesterol in serum samples using the CHOD-POD lit (Spinreact, Spain). Read the developed color at 450 nm using a Biotek instruments ELx800 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Sample Incubation and KCl Addition
steps.instruction: Keep samples in a boiling water bath for 45 minutes, then add 1 ml of 2% KCl to each sample at the end of the incubation.

steps.title: Measure Hemoglobin Concentration
steps.instruction: Prepare Drabkin's solution and measure hemoglobin concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Drabkin's solution by dissolving 200 mg K3[(CN)6] (Merck MilliporeSigma #702587), 50 mg KCN (Merck MilliporeSigma #207810), and 140 mg KH2PO4 (Merck MilliporeSigma #PHR1330) in 1000 ml water.
Add 1 ml of sample (extract, RBC, or serum) to 2 ml of Drabkin solution.
Centrifuge the sample if needed and measure the absorbance of the supernatant at 546 nm using a Beckman Coulter DU 640 spectrophotometer; otherwise, measure the sample directly.
Calculate hemoglobin concentration (gr/l) using a hemoglobin cyanide-standard or the molar absorption coefficient E=44 lnmol-1/mm-1 (Molecular weight of Hb: 64,458).

steps.title: Protein Analysis in Solution
steps.instruction: Analyze proteins in solution or those readily soluble in dilute alkali.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of Reagent C to a sample of 5 to 100 ul of protein (in 0.2 ml or less) in a 3 to 10 ml test-tube.
Mix well and allow to stand for at least 10 minutes at room temperature.
Rapidly add 0.10 ml of Reagent E and mix within one to two seconds.
After 30 minutes or longer, read the sample in a calorimeter or Beckman DU 640 spectrophotometer at or near 750 nm (for range 5 to 25 ul protein per ml final volume).
Calculate results from a standard curve.

steps.title: Determine Ammonia using GlDH
steps.instruction: Determine ammonia levels using glutamate dehydrogenase (GlDH).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.02 ml GlDH (3,000 U/ml in triethanolamine 150 mM pH 8 buffer; diluted 1:400; Merck MilliporeSigma #10197734001, Triethanolamine #90279) and mix.
Read absorbance every 20 minutes using a Beckman Coulter DU 640 spectrophotometer until stability is reached.
Calculate concentration from a standard curve using NH4Cl solution.
Add 0.005 ml urease solution (2.5kU/L; Merck MilliporeSigma #U7752) and mix.
After 15 minutes, read the final absorbance (A) at 339 nm using a Beckman Coulter DU 640 spectrophotometer.
Calculate delta A (A - A(0)), multiply by the sample pre-dilution factor, and use a standard curve with NH4Cl solution (Merck MilliporeSigma #254134).

steps.title: Determine Citrulline
steps.instruction: Perform a colorimetric reaction to determine citrulline content.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the reaction in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes.
Read the formed color at 460 nm using a Beckman Coulter DU 640 spectrophotometer against a water blank treated identically.
Divide the absorbance at 460 nm by 0.038 (absorbance for 1 pg of citrulline) to determine the micrograms of citrulline contained.
